queries:
WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    WHERE ea.average_amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget)
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    average_amount,
    average_amount - (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget) AS above_overall_average,
    average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM qualifying_events) AS gap_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying_events
ORDER BY gap_from_qualifying_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
),
qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
    HAVING AVG(amount) > (SELECT avg_amount FROM overall)
),
qualifying_lines AS (
    SELECT AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN qualifying_events AS q
      ON b.link_to_event = q.link_to_event
)
SELECT
    q.link_to_event,
    q.avg_amount,
    q.avg_amount - o.avg_amount AS above_overall_average,
    q.avg_amount - l.avg_amount AS gap_from_qualifying_line_mean
FROM qualifying_events AS q
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN qualifying_lines AS l
ORDER BY gap_from_qualifying_line_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_amount
    FROM event_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE ea.average_amount > o.mean_amount
),
qualifying_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_amount
    FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
    q.link_to_event,
    q.average_amount,
    q.average_amount - o.mean_amount AS gap_above_overall,
    q.average_amount - qm.mean_amount AS gap_above_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS qm
ORDER BY gap_above_qualifying_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_amount
    FROM event_averages
),
qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ea.average_amount > oa.average_amount
),
qualifying_line_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN qualifying_events AS q ON q.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
)
SELECT
    q.link_to_event,
    q.average_amount,
    q.average_amount - oa.average_amount AS above_overall_average,
    q.average_amount - qla.average_amount AS gap_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying_events AS q
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
CROSS JOIN qualifying_line_average AS qla
ORDER BY gap_from_qualifying_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
